text file, segment, routing, and checkpoint directories

compaction_and_projection.canonical_replay_decode_oom: reset partial decode, discard cache, retry authenticated artifacts with identical root

compaction_and_projection.canonical_replay_consumers: canonical metadata reduction and serving compaction, independent order
